source.label: Bethesda's Fallout 76 Community Calendar for Season 26 (September to December 2026)
source.note: Transcribed 2026-09-28 from the official calendar image (nukaknights.com/roadmaps.html mirrors it as fallou76-community-calendar-2026-q4-en.jpg). Event days run from daily reset to daily reset, noon Eastern. Mechanics notes are Bethesda's published event descriptions.

entries.name: Scrip Surplus
entries.note: Daily legendary scrip limit doubles from 500 to 1,000 per character at the Legendary Exchange.

entries.name: Double Mutations
entries.note: Daily Ops enemies carry two mutations; runs pay double XP, currency and Legendary Cores at Elder tier.

entries.name: The Slasher update
entries.note: Patch 70 and Season 26 begin. The Breaking News station starts the multi-week Slasher investigation; Legacy Seasons arrive.

entries.name: Caps-a-Plenty
entries.note: NPC vendors' daily caps pool doubles from 1,400 to 2,800.

entries.name: Seasonal Fish Run
entries.note: Seasonal fish bite more often; Captain Raymond's note points at the fall fishing spots.

entries.name: Treasure Hunter
entries.note: Legendary Treasure Hunter mole miners drop Mole Miner Pails (dusty, regular, ornate).

entries.name: Double Mutations
entries.note: Daily Ops enemies carry two mutations; runs pay double XP, currency and Legendary Cores at Elder tier.

entries.name: Mutated Public Events
entries.note: Hourly public events run with Daily Ops mutations; completion grants a Mutated Package (Mutated Party Pack for groups with three or more Fallout 1st members).

entries.name: Double Score Weekend
entries.note: Daily and weekly challenges award double S.C.O.R.E. toward Season 26 ranks.

entries.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
entries.note: Themed C.A.M.P. building contest run on Bethesda's Discord.

entries.name: Mischief Night
entries.note: JES-2R's hourly rampage at Rapidan Camp: fill three mayhem meters, then beat the security force for XP, caps, Legendary Modules and Halloween plans.

entries.name: Spooky Scorched

entries.name: Double XP
